overview_description.description:
NeoTAQ Systems is an Abu Dhabi-based (Masdar City) intelligent monitoring and control company built for critical infrastructure. Our platform delivers real-time monitoring, remote control, and asset management across energy, buildings, telecom, and manufacturing sectors.
Our ecosystem spans dataloggers, PV/DG controllers, BESS controllers, Power Plant Controllers (PPC), and SCADA — giving operators full visibility and control over their critical assets from a single platform.
NeoTAQ serves EPC companies, industrial facilities, and energy operators across emerging markets, with active deployments and early recurring revenue.
